newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade steady at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade steady at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade moderate for a brief period, mostly slow . Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry moderate, demand light.
Sales confirmed on 15,800 slaughter steers and 14,500 slaughter heifers early Tuesday. For the week to date 48,900 head and volume includes 10300 head of previously contracted and formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1260 lbs 66.00, few 65.50; mostly Select, few Choice 1150-1350 lbs 65.00-65.50.

Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1020-1260 lbs 66.00, few 65.00; mostly Select, few Choice 975-1050 lbs 65.00-65.50; few mixed Commercial to Choice heifers and heiferettes 1150-1175 lbs 63.50-64.00.
Week to date 48,900 last week 43,500 last year 34,700
